# Vendored geometry library

`polygon-clipping.js` is the unmodified browser UMD build from
[`polygon-clipping` 0.15.7](https://github.com/mfogel/polygon-clipping).
It is loaded locally to calculate floor unions, intersections and differences.

Licences accompanying this bundled code:

- `polygon-clipping.LICENSE.md`: polygon-clipping (MIT).
- `splaytree.LICENSE`: bundled splaytree (MIT); its attribution is also retained in the JavaScript header.
- `robust-predicates.LICENSE`: bundled robust-predicates (public domain / Unlicense).
- `Apache-2.0.LICENSE`: Microsoft TypeScript helper code (Apache 2.0); its notice is retained in the JavaScript header.
